en.title: Configuring Competition Divisions
en.excerpt: Detailed guide to defining bow divisions, age brackets, gender classes, and entry fees for archery tournaments.
en.content:
Understanding Competition Divisions

A competition category represents a specific competitive flight defined by four criteria: Bow Type, Age Class, Gender, and Shooting Distance. Archeris allows organizers to create unlimited distinct divisions per tournament.

Supported Bow Divisions

The platform natively supports all recognized archery disciplines:

  • Recurve: Olympic recurve with sights, stabilizers, and clickers.
  • Compound: Modern mechanical bows with magnifying scopes and release aids.
  • Barebow: Recurve bows without sights, stabilizers, or draw check devices.
  • Standar Bow / National: Wooden takedown recurve bows commonly used in developmental tournaments.
  • Traditional: Horsebows, longbows, and instinctive traditional wooden equipment.

Age Categories and Gender Classes

Configure standardized age brackets with automated date-of-birth verification during registration:

  • Youth Classes: Under 9 (U-9), Under 12 (U-12), Under 15 (U-15), and Under 18 (U-18).
  • Senior Class: Open age standard competitive division.
  • Master Class: 50 years of age and older.
  • Gender Segregation: Men (Putra), Women (Putri), or Open/Mixed categories.

Configuring Registration Fees

Organizers can configure individual pricing per division, including early bird promotional pricing and standard entry fees.
